scope: Only existing 96-capability rows; no V09/V10 expansion or new families

entries.title: CaBLAM
entries.dependencyChain: Five-residue coherent source topology -> exact pseudo-dihedrals/angles -> selected complete contours -> native interpolation and thresholds
entries.exactRemainingBlocker: Only a motif sample was acquired. It is not an outlier distribution. Full contour set is publicly located, but source-connected context, boundary equality and projection/degeneracy semantics remain unresolved; see FINAL_DOMAIN_REVIEW.txt.
entries.nextAction: Select a bounded backbone context and exact complete outlier/CA grid set; acquire and oracle-pin that set before implementation.

entries.title: RNA sugar pucker / suites
entries.dependencyChain: RNA ribose/base/phosphate exact state -> source-linked coherent atom tuples -> either pucker geometry or seven-angle suite profile
entries.exactRemainingBlocker: Pucker and suite are different protocols. Pucker source performs distance-based bond selection; Athena cannot inherit it as source topology. Suitename C/Python differ near cutoffs; cluster/options/runtime and terminal/modified-state handling need explicit selection.
entries.nextAction: Choose one exact pucker or suite profile; no combined universal RNA validator. Reuse geometry only after RNA source-admission is reviewed.

entries.title: Complete metal coordination geometry
entries.dependencyChain: Explicit Zn/donor identities -> independently supported complete first shell including water/symmetry/competing ligands -> selected geometry model
entries.exactRemainingBlocker: Four nearby donors establish neither first-shell admission nor completeness. No exact authoritative shell protocol/producer selected. Pairwise P07 proximity and I15 carbonyl geometry are not complete-sphere qualification.
entries.nextAction: Require a specific independently reviewed shell authority, treatment of bidentate/competing/water/symmetry states and chosen geometry comparison; no proximity-inferred closure.

entries.title: Serious clash classification
entries.dependencyChain: Exact H preparation/convention -> radii -> nonbonded/exclusion/DA/altloc/water policy -> overlap -> selected protocol category
entries.exactRemainingBlocker: Probe/MolProbity >0.4 A is inseparable from its full parameter system. No complete named runtime/parameter/preparation protocol selected. Existing I16 continuous gap cannot establish a serious clash.
entries.nextAction: Pin one full Probe-compatible protocol and independent oracle fixtures, including exclusions. Until then retain continuous I16 only.

entries.title: Diffraction / refinement validation

entries.exactRemainingBlocker: Official XML sample acquired, but no native structure-factor/uncertainty/free-flag/evaluator closure. Report preservation already exists; parsing a number does not qualify native validation.
entries.nextAction: Choose explicitly native reproduction versus bounded attributed report extraction; external report scope would not close native metrics.
